exposure: absent end-diastolic flow in the umbilical artery (UA-AEDF)
outcome: retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) requiring laser treatment
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 54 fetuses diagnosed with severe small for gestational age (SGA), defined as birth weight <=2.5 SD, categorized into UA-AEDF and non-UA-AEDF groups.
finding: UA-AEDF in severely SGA infants, especially those born before 32 weeks of gestation, is associated with higher rates of neonatal complications (RDS, circulatory dysfunction, metabolic acidosis, ROP) and poorer long-term neurodevelopmental outcomes (lower DQ scores).
birth_weight: severe SGA (defined as birth weight <=2.5 SD)
gest_age: Subgroup analysis focused on patients within 32 weeks of gestation.
